commits.message:
Reboot ModernWpf for 1.0.0-preview.1 (#688)

Establish the ModernWpf 1.x preview baseline, including the ModernWPF Gallery branding, complete release gate, package provenance, migration guidance, and protected tag-based publication workflow.

Reviewed source: maintenance-reboot-1x@15f6f4818a445f3924e69db91919d3927711c374
Reviewed tree: e33dcdabf1b2c9c576f01b06b9180e49da3dd73a

Avoid retaining hidden PasswordBox plaintext copies (#689)

Use SecurePassword for state checks and retain plaintext only while the reveal TextBox is intentionally visible. Clear the mirror when hidden or detached, add focused regression coverage, and document repository agent guardrails.

Fixes #331
Fix initial TextBox validation adorner cleanup (#691)

Fix white flicker while resizing modern windows on Windows 11 (#692)

Keep Windows 11 resize borders in the non-client frame for ModernWpf's full-glass custom window chrome, while preserving the legacy and High Contrast paths.

Fixes #683.

Honor the native minimize window style (#693)

Fixes #565.

Keep disabled caption buttons inert (#694)

Fixes #558.

Ignore transient transparent system accents (#695)

Fixes #549.

Fix ContentDialog lifecycle when owner is minimized (#697)

Keep ContentDialog open across parent-window minimize and restore transitions, and cover the two-window lifecycle with a regression test.

Closes #506.

Document how to build and run the Gallery (#698)

Closes #494

Update gradient brushes when accent changes (#699)

Closes #491

Fix the PowerShell sample runner (#700)

Fixes #447.
Fix NavigationView XAML pane state order (#704)
Fix modern window client hit testing (#706)
Fix TextBox clear button visibility opt-out (#712)
Enable touch panning for custom list views (#713)
Fix top navigation overflow layout loop (#319) (#716)
Keep CommandBarFlyout open during toggle binding sync (#720)

Bump setup-windows10-sdk-action from 1.5 to 1.12 (#722)

Bumps the github-actions group with 1 update in the / directory: [GuillaumeFalourd/setup-windows10-sdk-action](https://github.com/guillaumefalourd/setup-windows10-sdk-action).

Fix NavigationView NaN button sizing (#725)

Use measured dimensions when WPF NavigationView back and close template parts are Auto-sized, preventing GridLength(NaN) during resource teardown.

Fixes #268

Fix NumberBox float display precision (#726)

Normalize promoted Single values for NumberBox display without changing the underlying Value or genuine double precision.

Fixes #267

Allow CommandBar More button icon customization (#727)

Expose the unchanged More-button geometry as a public dynamic resource so individual CommandBars can replace it without a new CLR API or copied template.

Fixes #262

Fix ItemsRepeater DataTemplate teardown (#728)

Allow WPF template teardown to clear a resource-backed ItemsRepeater.ItemTemplate without treating the valid null state as an unsupported factory. Add the exact ListView replacement regression and document the WPF adaptation.

Fixes #257.

Fix custom title bar caption height (#729)

Synchronize TitleBar.HeightKey with the active WindowChrome caption height so the complete rendered title bar remains draggable.

Fixes #251

Let TitleBarButton text inherit the host font (#730)

Remove the obsolete symbol-font setter from TitleBarButton so arbitrary content inherits the host font while built-in icons continue to use geometry fallback.

Fixes #250.

Restore custom TextBox validation error bindings (#731)

Fixes #188

Remove obsolete repository assets (#740)

Remove verified-unreferenced documentation screenshots, Gallery media, legacy WinMD files, obsolete test helpers, and stale project entries. Add a Gallery asset-manifest regression test to protect retained resources.

Harden preview release versioning (#741)

Centralize the immutable 1.x compatibility baseline, derive release notes from the validated version, align public ModernWPF branding, and harden exact package selection in the manual release workflow.

Clean up preview API surface (#742)

Finalize the 1.0.0-preview.1 public API surface, retain StackPanelEx to avoid colliding with WPF StackPanel, clarify title-bar and automation-peer names, and harden Gallery test-host cleanup.

Finalize ModernWpf 1.0.0-preview.1 release (#748)

Locks the preview-1 compatibility and packaging contract, stabilizes the WPF test host, and fixes real High Contrast CommandBarFlyout rendering. Validated by the full release-gate, CodeQL, three local complete WinUI runs, packaged consumers, and manual checks on all supported targets.

Use NuGet Trusted Publishing (#750)

Replace the long-lived NuGet API-key dependency with a short-lived OIDC credential scoped to the protected release environment.

Clean up maintenance dependencies and tooling (#752)

Remove the unused WinUIResourcesConverter, rely on SDK SourceLink support, and centralize PublicApiAnalyzers 5.6.0 while recording existing delegate Invoke contracts.

Bump Fluent.Ribbon from 8.0.3 to 11.0.2 (#744)

Update the FluentRibbonSample dependency after full CI and manual startup, Backstage, theme, dialog, and window-chrome smoke testing.

Fix dark theme text entry carets (#753)

Bind AutoSuggestBox and toolbar text-entry carets to the theme foreground, add dark-theme Gallery regression coverage, and document the WPF adaptations.

Sync WinUI 3 controls and add continuous drift monitoring (#754)

Adopt the current WinUI 3 stable/main/Gallery sync epoch, port the applicable control fixes, revise preview compatibility governance, and add tested read-only upstream drift monitoring.

Bump the nuget-minor-and-patch group with 3 updates (#755)

Update Microsoft.Windows.CsWinRT to 1.6.5 and MSTest.TestAdapter/MSTest.TestFramework to 4.3.3.

Prepare ModernWPF 1.0.0-preview.2 adoption (#757)

Refresh Preview 2 package and repository presentation, add package-consumer and downstream-canary validation, freeze the reviewed upstream cutoff, and harden tagged Trusted Publishing release integrity.

Fix downstream canary environment (#758)

Make the three pinned downstream canaries reproducible and isolated, add the documented Preview 2 migrations, and lock package icon provenance.

Finalize Preview 2 release notes (#759)

Finalize the public 1.0.0-preview.2 release notes and record the accepted master downstream-canary evidence.

Start 1.0.0-preview.3 development (#761)

Advance development to Preview 3 and use the published Preview 2 package as the active validation baseline.

Add Preview 4 TitleBar and window materials (#763)

* Add Preview 4 TitleBar and window materials

* Start 1.0.0-preview.4 development

* Finalize 1.0.0-preview.4 release notes

Add Preview 5 TabView (#764)

* Add Preview 5 TabView

* Fix TabView automation provider tree

* Test TabView selection through the UIA tree

* Prepare Preview 5 release candidate

* Harden visual checks for WPF PNGs

* Keep TabView overflow controls reachable

* Finalize Preview 5 release notes

* Refresh public guidance for Preview 5

* Link current WinUI parity guidance

Add Preview 7 ItemsView visual evidence harness (#773)

Add a WinApp/WGC release-evidence harness for ItemsView across all supported frameworks and Light, Dark, and real OS High Contrast. Retain exact-commit environment, input, screenshot, report, and SHA-256 evidence, with source-shape guards against direct UIAutomationClient use.

Pin CI to .NET SDK 10.0.302 (#776)

Pin the repository to SDK 10.0.302 with roll-forward disabled. SDK 10.0.303 and 10.0.400 leak .NET 8 WPF reference assemblies into the net462 package-smoke markup project.

Fix Gallery close-button right-edge alignment (#775)

Remove the normal-window eight-DIP MainGrid inset so the close button reaches the rendered right edge. Preserve maximized and high-contrast chrome behavior and add a focused WPF regression test.

Closes #774.

Bump microsoft/setup-msbuild from 2 to 3 (#770)

Update the downstream-canary workflow to microsoft/setup-msbuild v3 after the full release gate and CodeQL checks passed.

Update test and Windows App SDK dependencies (#777)

Update Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk and the WinUI reference-capture Windows App SDK dependency. Keep the ModernWpfUI validation baseline review-controlled and exclude the repository self-package from Dependabot version updates.

Fix ContentDialog focus and grouped virtualization (#782)

Fix initial content focus and explicit grouping virtualization; keep the package smoke cache outside the consumer project to prevent cross-framework assembly resolution conflicts.

Closes #779
Closes #781

Prepare 1.0.0-rc.1 surface freeze and stabilization (#783)

* Prepare RC 1 contract freeze and recycle RadioButtons containers

* Align source audit gates with RC shipped inventories and cutoff

* Refresh upstream drift fixtures for the RC 1 epoch

* Correct RC top-level type totals from assembly metadata

* Fix Gallery theme selection when reopening settings

* Fix command bar ellipsis foreground in high contrast

* Make RC overflow tests independent of window chrome and finalize notes
